tips: Food is your only healing. There are no potions. Clear Soup is the cheapest good option. Cook at a campfire or a camp cooking station.
Palmar Pills revive you at about 30% HP. Craft them from water plus insects or plants.
Damaged gear can't be repaired, so sell it for Silver.
Refinement at the Blacksmith: levels 1-4 need basic materials, 5 and up also need Abyss Artifacts. Inspect > Refinement Information shows every level's cost.
A successful parry refills Stamina and Spirit. Running out of Stamina leaves you stuck mid-dodge or mid-climb.
Fast travel: stand on an Abyss Nexus (white circle, 'Mysterious Energy') until it glows to unlock it.
Feed your horse hay, sugar beets or Horse Tonic. A starved horse slows to a crawl.
Vendor stock refreshes every in-game day. Sell books and recipes after reading them; your journal keeps them.
Camp upgrades come from Greymane faction quests, not a menu.
Using an item from the quick menu only slows time. Open the full inventory to pause.
